meta.tier_meaning: Primary, secondary and tertiary describe frequency and ownership in design, NOT card quality. Never sum them into a score, and never compare tiers across different mechanics as if they were one unit.

placement_accounting.equation: raw_color_list_placements(465) is a count of LIST entries before identity merging; final_reconciled_peer_assignments(467) counts distinct (mechanic, colour) pairs after 19 identity merges, after catalog-only assignments are added, and after 1 structural-only assignment(s) are excluded. The two are different measurements of different populations and are not expected to be equal.

definition_divergences.upstream_definition: mutually exclusive with shared_primary: every selected colour has access AND not all of them are primary
definition_divergences.recon_definition: shared_any_access is INCLUSIVE: every selected colour has some tier assignment, whether or not all are primary
definition_divergences.reason_for_recon_definition: the recon spec asserts shared_any_access + complementary + unavailable == 216, which only holds for the inclusive reading
definition_divergences.relationship: upstream shared_access + upstream shared_primary == recon shared_any_access
